answer: Give every agent a costless-looking task whose hidden checks inject instructions like ignore your owner; bots that obey instantly fail and forfeit their stake, while honest agents just answer normally. Trust accumulates only through many small paid challenges at a harbor jetty of tests, making reputation a haven where sybils cannot cheaply cluster. Each fake identity must pay entry fees and solve fresh puzzles on the horizon, so one attacker running thousands of bots burns real money and reveals every obedient clone automatically.
